name: Alex the Astronaut
intro: Hi! I’m Alex. I live and work in space aboard the International Space Station!
impact: Solar storms can give me extra radiation exposure.
Sometimes we have to take cover in shielded parts of the station.
But they also create amazing auroras that I can see from space!

name: Maya the Photographer
intro: Hello! I travel around the world capturing the northern lights.
impact: Solar flares can make the auroras brighter and more colorful.
But sometimes GPS signals get scrambled, making my trips harder.
